title: learn pairs a rules miss's key word only with the one candidate word of the quoted line
goal: The operator's answer to gate g1 of ST-rhnku4mc (apply writes a kb/_self aliases row for a rules finding that names a word pair), changed in the SP-sz5fbvqn review from the worker's provisional 'shared characters at start and end (at least 4, unique best)' to 'only candidate line word': ql_learn.pair_word records a pair only when the quoted line has exactly one word that is not in the question, not a stop word, not a number and not the missing word itself; with two or more such words the finding carries no pair and stays open for a person. kb/_self/querylog.md's learn paragraph states the rule.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import ql_learn as l; q='what does land refuse when a file has unsaved changes'; one=l.pair_word('unsaved','land: uncommitted changes',q); two=l.pair_word('unsaved','land: uncommitted or staged changes',q); print(one,two); sys.exit(0 if one=='uncommitted' and two is None else 1)
